API ReferenceZscaler Client Connector APIPublic API ControllerForce removes enrolled devices
Force removes enrolled devices
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/forceRemoveDevices

Force removes the enrolled device from the portal. You can only remove devices that are in registered or device removal pending state. At least one criterion (username, Zscaler Client Connector version, OS type, or UDID) must be specified to remove devices.

The following are the valid values for the osType attribute. The default value is null, which represents ALL OS types.

1 - iOS
2 - Android
3 - Windows
4 - macOS
5 - Linux
Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 30.

Default value: 30
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

string[]

int32
